name: Doji bar OCO breakout (long above / short below) with tick TP/SL
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
indicators: Doji body ratio, long candle ratio 0.7, volume EMA
entry_long: On a doji bar (|close-open| <= 5% of range): place buy-stop at the highest of high and previous high (or the doji high if previous bar was long and bigger); optional volume > EMA(24) filter.
entry_short: Sell-stop at the lowest of low and previous low (OCA cancels the other side).
exit: Take profit 200 ticks and stop loss 200 ticks (inputs); if SL/TP disabled, close when price breaks the doji low.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited source; verify execution timing (signal bar vs next open) before implementation.
